222-527-2438-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2438-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1981-2415-5933-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

512-1129-7014.easyPrerequisites: Harabaz Druid and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-1129-7014.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Harabaz Druid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1129-7014.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Harabaz Druid's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2741-4399-4770-5998.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2741-4399-4770-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1003-3652-6516-7735.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3652-6516-7735.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2146-4200-6626-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-3311-7278.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-3311-7278.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Slash, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Snake Umbra triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7296-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7296-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1069-1232-5499-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1232-5499-7296.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

5010-5231-5708-6900.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

5220-5231-5741.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {R} or less.
5220-5231-5741.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-5231-6633.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2506-2721-5256.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-4720-5390-5516.easyPrerequisites: Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
3525-4720-5390-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Red Death.
3525-4720-5390-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

1789-5147-5649-5929.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-5147-5649-5929.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1365-1379-4853-5231--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-1379-4853-5231--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Repeat.

81-4019.notablePrerequisites: Kami of Whispered Hopes has at least one +1/+1 counter on it, has power 3 or greater, and does not have summoning sickness.
81-4019.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.
81-4019.notes: Once you have infinite blue mana, you may add any color of mana using Kami of Whispered Hopes.

2292-2730-3719-5131.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya's Ghostform attached to Muldrotha.
You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn if Ruthless Technomancer is in your graveyard.
2292-2730-3719-5131.description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer either from your hand or graveyard by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Muldrotha and create six Treasure artifact tokens.
When Muldrotha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, causing you to scry 1.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{B}.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard by paying {B}, attaching it to Muldrotha.
Repeat.

4302-4509-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing another Angel.
When the Angel dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
When the Angel enters, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

864-2034-4872-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a creature spell using Muldrotha this turn.
864-2034-4872-5131.description:
Cast Eternal Witness from your graveyard by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

541-1367-3632-3634.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
In response, activate Erratic Portal by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
